hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { uv run --quiet ruff check --fix --quiet "$f"; uv run --quiet ruff format --quiet "$f"; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: ruff: fixing and formatting the edited file
